description.value:
At 5th level, your connection to the moon grows stronger, allowing you to draw upon a selection of powerful spells determined by your Lunar Cycle phase. You regain the ability to use this trait when you finish a long rest.

  • New Moon phase: You can cast either the @Compendium[undertaking.spells-level-3.Z373UKDNQ9VFAMQD]{Syzygy} or @Compendium[undertaking.spells-level-3.XD6W9NSEKZ48HGCD]{Dispel Magic} spell once with this trait.
  • Full Moon phase: You can cast either the @Compendium[undertaking.spells-level-3.6GFN59MWTZPMBQ61]{Haste} or @Compendium[undertaking.spells-level-3.FOW5GSST2ZXRMKJ4]{Illusory Creature} spell once with this trait.
